first_open_aria:
- region "Add task":
  - heading "Add task" [level=2]
  - button "Close capture"
  - form "Quick capture":
    - text: Quick capture
    - textbox "Quick capture":
      - /placeholder: "For example: tomorrow 14:00 Discuss the plan #work /Project"
      - text: 分享标题 复核
    - button "Add"
    - paragraph: "Separate the date, time, #tags and /project with spaces. The current project scope is used by default (All projects uses Inbox)."
  - paragraph: "No deadline · Project: Inbox"
  - button "Full form"
